claims.text: The Rijksmuseum is the national museum of the Netherlands, entirely dedicated to showcasing the country's extraordinary arts and history.
claims.subject: self

claims.text: Originally founded in The Hague on 19 November 1798, the museum moved to Amsterdam in 1808 and eventually settled in its current grand building.
claims.subject: self

claims.text: The magnificent main building was designed by the architect Pierre Cuypers and first opened its doors in 1885.
claims.subject: self

claims.text: Inside, you will find 8,000 objects of art and history on display, drawn from an enormous total collection of one million objects.
claims.subject: self

claims.text: Among those treasures are some undisputed masterpieces by the legendary painters Rembrandt, Frans Hals, and Johannes Vermeer.
claims.subject: self

claims.text: It holds the remarkable distinction of being the most visited and the largest art museum in the entire country.
claims.subject: self
